snippet.title: Rise And Fall S2 - Trailer | Virender Sehwag, Swara, Karan, Shehzad, Priyanka | Prime Video
snippet.description:
Rise And Fall Season 2 - Official Trailer

26th Sept se maza toh bahut aayega 🙌  
Watch #RiseAndFallS2, on Prime Video and MX Player, for free.

Special Partner: LUX Nitro - @luxindltd 
Safety Partner: Mallcom India - @MallcomIndia 

Hosted by - Virender Sehwag
Contestants: 15 celebrities, including Swara Bhasker, Karan Patel, Priyanka Chahar Choudhary, Shehzad Poonawalla, and more.

Showrunner: Priya Bhave
Senior Creative Director:  Ketan Mangaonkar
Production House: Seventaurus Entertainment Studio PVT LTD (Banijay Asia)
Producer: Deepak Dhar, Rishi Negi, Mrinalini Jain, Shyam Rathi
CO-Producer: Girish Balan
Writer: Jatin Sharma
Language: Hindi
Genre: Unscripted

About the Show:
Rise And Fall Season 2 is a high-stakes social experiment divided between Workers and Rulers. The second season returns with a bigger game, higher stakes and even more power at play. 

Workers live in the Basement, surviving with limited resources while taking on challenges and facing elimination. Their goal is to Rise into the Penthouse and become Rulers. Rulers live in luxury, control resources and make key decisions, while fighting to avoid the Fall back to the Basement, where they become vulnerable to elimination. Only a Ruler can win.

The Lift connects these two worlds, becoming a powerful symbol of the contestants’ rise and fall. The Red Room is where Rulers make crucial decisions that shift power and determine fates, while the Factory is the rugged, flexible arena for the show’s biggest challenges. Through all the power shifts, risks and battles, one ultimate winner will emerge from the Rulers.

About Prime Video:
Prime Video is India’s largest streaming service for exclusive Originals — a one-stop entertainment destination in India offering blockbuster Originals and exclusive titles included with Prime, in addition to the widest a selection of movie rentals, and 30+ add-on subscriptions (Apple TV+, Lionsgate Play, Discovery+ Crunchyroll, BBC Player, Sony Pictures – Stream, MGM+ to name a few). With the integration of the free video streaming service ‘Amazon MX Player’ into Prime Video, the unified service now offers a deeper, richer selection for an even wider base of audiences in India, with a variety of Indian and international movies and shows across Hindi, English, Tamil, Telugu, Malayalam, Kannada, and more. Prime Video is home to fan-favorites like Mirzapur, The Family Man, Panchayat, Paatal Lok, Farzi, Raakh, Subedaar, Matka King, Call Me Bae, Dhootha, Inspector Rishi, Traitors, Rise & Fall, Sankalp, Jamnapaar, Aashram and Made In India: A Titan Story. Global hits include Project Hail Mary, Off Campus, The Boys,  The Lord of The Rings: The Rings of Power, Jack Ryan, The Summer I Turned Pretty, amongst others. Prime Video offers every kind of entertainment, for every kind of viewer, all in one place. For more information on Prime Video, visit www.amazon.com/primevideo.

snippet.title: Pahije (Official Music Video) Sanju Rathod | Juilee Joglekar | G-SPXRK | Ft. Saumya Kamble
snippet.description:
What happens when her wishes meet his promise to make them all come true?

A very energetic and a fun-filled Marathi love story packed with nakhras, compliments, dreams, dance & the sweet chemistry of a couple enjoying life together from Goa plans to matching outfits, every little moment becomes a reason to celebrate.

Let the music take over and dance your way into their world!

Lyrics:

मला shopping पाहिजे म्हणजे पाहिजे
(I want to go shopping, no matter what.)

कपडे matching पाहिजे म्हणजे पाहिजे
(I want matching clothes.)

मला गोव्याला जायचा, मला picture बघायचा
(I want to visit Goa and watch a movie.)

मला सगळंच पाहिजे म्हणजे पाहिजे
(I want everything.)

Chorus

ओके, देतो तुला सारं काही आज ग
राणी माझ्या सोबत नाच ग
सोडूनी आज सारी लाज ग
राणी माझ्या सोबत नाच ग

(Okay, I’ll give you everything today. My queen, dance with me and leave your shyness behind.)

Verse 2

कधी कधी घालून येते ती वेणी
आईशप्पथ काय दिसते, अव्वल तिची श्रेणी
हा तिला बघून जळतात सतराशे जणी
कारण तिच्या सोबत असतो मुलगा गुणी

(Sometimes she comes with braided hair and looks stunning. Many girls envy her because she’s with a worthy guy.)

Verse 3

गुणी गुण तिच्यात छत्तीस नाय शंबर
ती घरातली लक्ष्मी, वाढला पैशांचा नंबर

(She has hundreds of qualities and brings prosperity to the home.)

Dialect Lines

म केरोजे खोटो तोन वाटो तो केदेस
नायतो राणी छाती फाडन कळजो मारो लेलेस

(A playful promise that if he lies, his queen will punish him.)

Verse 4

तुझ्यासाठी हलवून टाकलं ही दुनिया
कारण माझी खूबसूरत दुल्हनिया
हा मी पण काय desi global sensation
हा होणारा हर एक क्षेत्राचा राजा

(I turned the world upside down for my beautiful bride. I’m desi, yet a global sensation, destined to rule every field.)

Verse 5

कालच दिली तिने सोन्याची ring
आणि अहो-जाहो केलं, आली भारी feeling
त्या खुशीमध्ये केली मी पहिल्यांदा drink
कधी रडलो, कधी पडलो, माझा mood झाला swing

(She gave me a gold ring. Overwhelmed with happiness, I had my first drink and experienced an emotional swing.)

Dialect Hook

वेतडूरो पेट मोटो
उपरेसी सेट बेटो

(Everything is great and set—let’s enjoy!)

Verse 6

ये माझी जान, तू फूल मी पाखली
Gift करू वाटे सोन्याची साखळी
खोल ग पापणी दिवस-रात नी
भूक लागली की पिठलं-भाकरी

(My love, you’re the flower and I’m the butterfly. I want to gift you a gold chain and enjoy pithla-bhakri together.)

Verse 7

मराठी मुलगी, तुझा जवाब नी
हजारो नखरे, केवढा रुबाब नी
मी ओळखतो तुला
You wanna go shopping
स्वतःच्या जीवावर, स्वतःच्या cash नी

(Marathi girl, you’re unmatched. I know you want to shop using your own money.)

Verse 8

थिरी थिरी नाचतो ग तुझा साजना
बांधला ग तुझ्यासाठी मोठा बंगला
पोरगा गुणाचा हा मोकळ्या मनाचा
करतो ग तुझ्याशी हा प्यार तगडा

(Your beloved dances joyfully. I’m good-hearted, open-minded & love you deeply.)

Final Chorus

I want shopping, matching clothes, Goa and a movie - I want everything!

Lyrics:

मला shopping पाहिजे म्हणजे पाहिजे
(I want to go shopping, no matter what.)

कपडे matching पाहिजे म्हणजे पाहिजे
(I want matching clothes.)

मला गोव्याला जायचा, मला picture बघायचा
(I want to visit Goa and watch a movie.)

मला सगळंच पाहिजे म्हणजे पाहिजे
(I want everything.)

Chorus

ओके, देतो तुला सारं काही आज ग
राणी माझ्या सोबत नाच ग
सोडूनी आज सारी लाज ग
राणी माझ्या सोबत नाच ग

(Okay, I’ll give you everything today. My queen, dance with me and leave your shyness behind.)

Verse 2

कधी कधी घालून येते ती वेणी
आईशप्पथ काय दिसते, अव्वल तिची श्रेणी
हा तिला बघून जळतात सतराशे जणी
कारण तिच्या सोबत असतो मुलगा गुणी

(Sometimes she comes with braided hair and looks stunning. Many girls envy her because she’s with a worthy guy.)

Verse 3

गुणी गुण तिच्यात छत्तीस नाय शंबर
ती घरातली लक्ष्मी, वाढला पैशांचा नंबर

(She has hundreds of qualities and brings prosperity to the home.)

Dialect Lines

म केरोजे खोटो तोन वाटो तो केदेस
नायतो राणी छाती फाडन कळजो मारो लेलेस

(A playful promise that if he lies, his queen will punish him.)

Verse 4

तुझ्यासाठी हलवून टाकलं ही दुनिया
कारण माझी खूबसूरत दुल्हनिया
हा मी पण काय desi global sensation
हा होणारा हर एक क्षेत्राचा राजा

(I turned the world upside down for my beautiful bride. I’m desi, yet a global sensation, destined to rule every field.)

Verse 5

कालच दिली तिने सोन्याची ring
आणि अहो-जाहो केलं, आली भारी feeling
त्या खुशीमध्ये केली मी पहिल्यांदा drink
कधी रडलो, कधी पडलो, माझा mood झाला swing

(She gave me a gold ring. Overwhelmed with happiness, I had my first drink and experienced an emotional swing.)

Dialect Hook

वेतडूरो पेट मोटो
उपरेसी सेट बेटो

(Everything is great and set—let’s enjoy!)

Verse 6

ये माझी जान, तू फूल मी पाखली
Gift करू वाटे सोन्याची साखळी
खोल ग पापणी दिवस-रात नी
भूक लागली की पिठलं-भाकरी

(My love, you’re the flower and I’m the butterfly. I want to gift you a gold chain and enjoy pithla-bhakri together.)

Verse 7

मराठी मुलगी, तुझा जवाब नी
हजारो नखरे, केवढा रुबाब नी
मी ओळखतो तुला
You wanna go shopping
स्वतःच्या जीवावर, स्वतःच्या cash नी

(Marathi girl, you’re unmatched. I know you want to shop using your own money.)

Verse 8

थिरी थिरी नाचतो ग तुझा साजना
बांधला ग तुझ्यासाठी मोठा बंगला
पोरगा गुणाचा हा मोकळ्या मनाचा
करतो ग तुझ्याशी हा प्यार तगडा

(Your beloved dances joyfully. I’m good-hearted, open-minded & love you deeply.)

Final Chorus

I want shopping, matching clothes, Goa and a movie - I want everything!

snippet.description:
বিশ্বকর্মা পুজো উপলক্ষ্যে শুনে নিন বিভবেন্দু ভট্টাচার্যের সঙ্গীতায়োজনে ও কণ্ঠে 'বিশ্বকর্মা প্রণাম মন্ত্র' সম্পূর্ণ লিরিক্সসহ, শুধুমাত্র @aalosocial-এ।

On the occasion of Bishwakarma Puja, listen to ‘Bishwakarma Pranam Mantra’, arranged and sung by Bibhendu Bhattacharya, complete with lyrics, only on @aalosocial.

-----------------------------------------------------------------

Sanskrit stotras compilation, composition & Bengali stuti re-creation: Bibhabendu Bhattacharya
Music arrangement, direction and voice: Bibhabendu Bhattacharya
Acoustic Guitar: Gourab Das
Flute: Shubhomoy Ghosh
Rhythm: Sumit Kr Poddar
Audio recording: SUROBAIBHAB
Audio mixing & Mastering: Prem (Chotka) Karmakar
Sanskrit mantras presentation guidance: Tapaprakash Bhattacharya 

-----------------------------------------------------------------

snippet.description:

Directed by Goldi Jaiswal, the song features a talented creative team including DOP Rajan Verma, Editor R. Ninja and DI Rohit Singh.

🎵 Turn up the volume and enjoy FALANA KE PATOH!

👍 Like | 💬 Comment | 🔔 Subscribe

snippet.title: Debasilip Biswkarma Nka Aji Janama  ll ଦେବଶିଳ୍ପୀ ବିଶ୍ଵକର୍ମାଙ୍କ ଆଜି ଜନମ ଦିନ ll Pragnyashree Nayak 🙏
snippet.description:
#Jayaprabhu #Biswakarma #Jayabiswabindhani #Saipragnyacreation #Pragnyashree newsongrealise #biswakarmapuja2026 #biswakarmapujastatus #biswakarmajewelleryshilpalaya #biswakarmapujawhatsopstatus #Biswakarigara #Biswabindhani #Pragnyashreenewbiswakarmasong #
​🛠️ ସୃଷ୍ଟିର ଆଦି ଶିଳ୍ପୀ ଭଗବାନ୍ ବିଶ୍ୱକର୍ମା! ⚙️
​ଯାହାଙ୍କ ଦିବ୍ୟ ସୃଷ୍ଟି ଓ କାରିଗରୀ ବିନା ଏ ସଂସାରର ନିର୍ମାଣ ଅସମ୍ଭବ। ସ୍ୱର୍ଣ୍ଣ ଲଙ୍କାରୁ ଦ୍ୱାରକା, ଇନ୍ଦ୍ରଙ୍କ ବଜ୍ରରୁ ଶ୍ରୀଜଗନ୍ନାଥଙ୍କ ଦାରୁରୂପ— ସବୁଥିରେ ରହିଛି ବିଶ୍ୱକର୍ମାଙ୍କ ଅଦ୍ଭୁତ କଳାର ସ୍ପର୍ଶ।
​ଆସନ୍ତୁ ଏହି ପବିତ୍ର ବିଶ୍ୱକର୍ମା ପୂଜାରେ ଆମର କର୍ମ, ସାଧନା ଓ ନିର୍ମାଣର ଦେବତାଙ୍କୁ ପ୍ରଣାମ ଜଣାଇବା। ସମସ୍ତଙ୍କୁ ବିଶ୍ୱକର୍ମା ପୂଜାର ହାର୍ଦ୍ଦିକ ଅଭିନନ୍ଦନ! 🌸🙏
🎼Song :: Debasilpi Biswakarma Nka Aji Janama dina
🎧Singer :: Pragnyashree Nayak 
✒️Lyrics :: Muralidhar Das 
🎶Music :: Priyadarshini Nayak
